title: BBAI: Up 20% in a Week. The 10-Q Still Has No Ask Sage Number.
author: Kind-Independence-67

comments.author: Kind-Independence-67
comments.body:
The exhibit from the 10-Q:



Funded backlog, in the company's own table: $76.5M funded against $253.6M of unfunded backlog and options — $330.1M total. The funded share is 23.2%, down from \~29% in Q2, under the $100M line the checks set before the print. The order book is real paper. The funded part — the part with appropriated money behind it — is the smaller, shrinking slice.
